snippet.title: Gombo -  Green Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Gombo is available in Early Access on Steam. Get it now or wishlist:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649860/Gombo/

Explore, build, and battle your way through a magical hand-drawn world
In Gombo, you’ll dive into a vibrant adventure where survival, creativity, and action go hand in hand. Whether venturing out solo or teaming up in seamless peer-to-peer two-player co-op, you’ll uncover a world full of mystery, danger, and charm.

Are you afraid of the night?
While the world appears to be friendly and beautiful during the day, this changes at night. A mysterious infection is haunting the world and it’s growing only at night! Beware of what it does to the world’s inhabitants, as they get mad and deformed by the infection. Can you find out what’s happening and save the world?

Gather Resources and Craft Everything you need to Survive
Explore lush forests, haunted woods and dungeons full resources to fuel your survival. Use what you find to craft everything from powerful weapons to handy tools and helpful utilities. Build shelters, outposts, and full-on homesteads wherever your journey takes you. Set up farms, grow your own crops, and transform wild terrain into a place to call home. Care for your pets and take them on a ride.

Fight Ferocious Enemies and Colossal Bosses
The world of Gombo may look playful, but danger lurks around every corner. Face off against a wide range of imaginative creatures, cunning elite foes, and massive bosses that will test your skills. Harness magical powers and unlock transformative abilities to turn the tide of battle and keep the chaos at bay.


A Living World Full of Stories and Secrets
Gombo’s world is alive with detail, brimming with dynamic biomes, hand-crafted dungeons, and a deadly day and night cycle. Embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of these enchanted lands, take on quirky sidequests and meet a colorful cast of characters eager to lend a hand - or stir up trouble.


Play It Your Way
Customize your character from head to toe and find a wide range of outfits and styles on your travels. Play at your own pace - solo or with a friend in smooth peer-to-peer online co-op. Gombo supports controllers and is optimized for Steam Deck, making it easy to jump into the adventure however and wherever you want.
